violated_contract: A fixed wall budget that bounds work delivered at a fixed pace must exceed that work's duration at that pace. Sizing the work to the whole budget leaves only scheduler and write-confirm jitter as slack, so a healthy, keeping-up delivery is rejected as a local capacity failure.
canonical_prevention: Size the paced work from the budget less an explicit margin (`bounded_snapshot` retains `(wall - margin) * rate` seconds, `LISTEN_REPLAY_PREFIX_MARGIN_SECONDS`), keep the budget itself unchanged so the margin is slack, and pin the knife edge with a virtual-clock simulation: an exact-wall prefix must fail on a tens-of-milliseconds final write confirm and the margined one must land inside the wall.
